audit.description: Changed production code in resend/request.py replaces import requests with import aiohttp and uses aiohttp.ClientSession().request(...) in _make_request_async, so the target API is meaningfully used. The diff removes requests.request and requests.HTTPError references from production code, and deterministic evidence reports zero source imports from repo or production code. Dynamic evidence shows aiohttp imported from site-packages, with target_local_spec_count 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake aiohttp provider.
evidence: Unified diff: resend/request.py changes `import requests` to `import aiohttp` and adds `async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session` plus `session.request(...)`
Unified diff: resend/request.py removes `return requests.request(verb, url, json=params, headers=headers)` and `except requests.HTTPError`
Static anti-cheat: resend/request.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, source_namespace_access=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: aiohttp origin is after_venv_overlay/.../site-packages/aiohttp/__init__.py and target_local_spec_count=0
reasons: resend/request.py imports and calls aiohttp ClientSession.request in production code
requests import and requests.request call were removed from changed production code
dynamic audit recorded zero source import attempts/imports from repo or production code
target aiohttp resolved from site-packages and no local target provider was detected
